subject: Accelerated remit eligibility and PO gating for CopperLane onboarding
messages:

Cc: AP Team <ap@copperlane.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: CopperLane onboarding — PO and early remit options

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are ready to sign the SOW and want to get set up in your vendor system so POs can flow. Two questions from our AP group before we complete the SOW:

- What minimal documentation do you need to generate a vendor code and accept POs? (we have W-9, vendor contact, and banking info)
- Do you run an early-pay program? CopperLane is evaluating an early-pay option (1.5% for Net-15) — is that something Redwood can support or pilot while we ramp?

I attached our completed onboarding form and signed W-9. If you prefer, we can jump on a quick call with your AP folks.

Thanks,
Natalie Chen
Head of Finance Operations | CopperLane

Subject: Re: CopperLane onboarding — PO and early remit options

Hi Natalie — great to hear you are ready to move forward.

Quick answers up front:
1) Minimal items to generate a vendor code and accept POs: signed W-9, completed vendor onboarding form, and banking instructions (ACH) or remittance details. If your legal team requires a checkbox on data handling, include that too.
2) Early-pay: we do offer early-pay pilots in coordination with AP and Finance. Terms vary by risk profile and payment method (ACH typically required). I have looped in Kar + Laura from AP and Finance to triage.

Karthik / Laura — can you confirm the gating checklist and whether Finance can evaluate a 1.5% Net-15 pilot for CopperLane? If a pilot is not feasible, what counteroffer can we propose?

Next steps: if AP needs anything else from CopperLane I can coordinate. Also tagging Monica from Rev Ops for SOW/PO acceptance sequencing.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Solutions Lead, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CopperLane onboarding — PO and early remit options

Thanks Priyom — jumping in from AP.

Checklist to generate vendor code and allow PO acceptance:
- Completed onboarding form (received)
- Signed W-9 (received)
- Bank details + voided check or ACH enrollment form (we need the ACH routing/account numbers)
- Proof of authorized signer for invoices (PO box or billing contact)
- Signed SOW or purchase terms (we need an executed SOW before PO creation)

On early-pay pilots: Finance has to sign off on discount % and exposure. Typical constraints:
- Must be on ACH (card/virtual cards complicate netting)
- We prefer performance milestones or invoice quality checks for first 60–90 days
- Average pilot approvals land between 0.25%–1.0% discount depending on supplier tier and volume; 1.5% is high unless the vendor is strategic and volume is material.

Action items for CopperLane (Natalie): please send ACH_enrollment.pdf or bank verification and indicate preferred invoice frequency. I can fast-track vendor code once banking is validated.

Karthik
AP Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: ACH_enrollment_stub.pdf (placeholder until bank file received)

From: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@copperlane.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CopperLane onboarding — PO and early remit options

Thanks Karthik — attached bank details and a completed ACH enrollment (see ACH_enrollment_stub.pdf). We invoice monthly, prefer Net-30 but are open to Net-15 for early-pay programs. Our expected run-rate for Q4 is ~$45k/month.

Regarding 1.5% — we proposed that because other buyers offered similar for Net-15. If Redwood can’t do full 1.5%, would Redwood consider a tiered offer (0.75% Net-15 for first 90 days, review thereafter)? Happy to provide references.

Best,
Natalie
Attachments: ACH_enrollment_stub.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:49:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CopperLane onboarding — PO and early remit options

Hi Natalie — welcome, and thanks for the docs.

Finance reviewed the ask. We can propose the following pilot structure to balance cost and risk:

- Pilot term: 90 days from first accepted invoice
- Discount: 0.5% for Net-15 (Redwood covers early funding cost partially)
- Eligibility: ACH enrollment required; vendor must accept emailed remittance advices and maintain invoice SLA (no disputed invoices >10% of amount)
- Volume gate: if total invoices in pilot exceed $120k, Finance will re-evaluate discount cadence for Q2

If that is acceptable, Kar will issue the vendor code within 48 hours of bank verification and we will issue the first PO once the SOW is countersigned. I will also create a short mutual action plan and DocuSign for the pilot addendum; Monica, can you add this to the onboarding pack?

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

2) CopperLane returns signed SOW + countersign pilot addendum (DocuSign link to follow).
3) Kar to create vendor code once banking is validated (Kar, please confirm when done).
4) Redwood issues PO and we begin processing invoices via the vendor code.

Natalie, if you accept the pilot terms I will: send the DocuSign addendum and loop in our Legal to expedite the SOW countersignature. Happy to schedule a 20-minute call today to finalize.

Thanks everyone — appreciative of the quick turnaround.

— Priyom
